observed_compatibility_changes: Opt-in dynamic Any comparison methods now cover Any operands and CPython rich-comparison order across direct comparisons, container search and dictionary lookup.
NamedTuple values compare and hash structurally through Any; Any items participate in typed tuple/iterator equality.
format() on Any, slices, type identity/module/qualname, sum(generator) and dict.update gain the selected behavior covered by the new programs.
Nested display dry-run memoization prevents the retained 199-depth program from exceeding the 20-second hosted bound.
The JIT driver keeps cold functions in .text so LLVM 18 ORC retains the moved landing pads exercised by dynany_jit_try.
documented_deviations: A comparison method with a concrete or unsupported annotation, or a body that cannot compile for Any, may not run in cases where CPython runs it; identity or generic ordering behavior can remain.
Custom objects are not iterable through Any, so a custom pair object supplied to dict.update raises TypeError rather than being iterated as in CPython.
